ProjectDesc: AmbuTRX is a Proof of Concept (POC) developed for the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Neuro & Stroke. It is an AI-enhanced pre-hospital stroke communication system that converts paramedic speech into structured clinical reports, helping the A&E team prepare before patient arrival.

OrthoSight is a Proof of Concept (POC) developed for the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Orthopaedics. It is an AI-powered computer vision solution for rapid, non-invasive spinal alignment and scoliosis screening, supporting preliminary orthopaedic assessment and review.
